# Vendor record template

Version 0.1 · Prepared 2026-10-13 · Proposed operating practice pending owner adoption

Private vendor ID [[VENDOR_ID]] · Owner [[VENDOR_OWNER]] · Reviewed [[REVIEW_DATE]]

- Legal provider, official URL, service and business purpose: [[VENDOR_IDENTITY]] / [[VENDOR_SERVICE]]
- Client/project dependencies and criticality: [[AFFECTED_SERVICES]] / [[VENDOR_CRITICALITY]]
- Account owner, authorized users and private vault reference: [[VENDOR_ACCOUNT_OWNER]] / [[ACCESS_INVENTORY]]
- Data categories/locations/subprocessors and approved access: [[VENDOR_DATA_REVIEW]]
- Plan, currency, unit basis, seats, taxes, usage limits and estimated total: [[VENDOR_COST_BASIS]]
- Client or Noirdaz payer and billing method reference, no account numbers: [[VENDOR_PAYER]]
- Initial term, billing cadence, auto-renewal, next renewal and cancellation notice deadline: [[VENDOR_TERM]]
- Price change, cancellation, refund, data export and deletion restrictions: [[VENDOR_EXIT_TERMS]]
- Terms/privacy/DPA/security review URLs and accepted version/date: [[VENDOR_TERMS_RECORD]]
- SLA/support, incident channel, backup/recovery limits and insurance concern: [[VENDOR_SERVICE_RISKS]]
- Alternatives, exit effort and recovery/export test: [[VENDOR_EXIT_PLAN]]
- Approval in principle and separate final execution confirmation: [[VENDOR_APPROVAL_RECORD]]
- Last actual cost, variance, next review and action: [[VENDOR_REVIEW_STATUS]]

This is a planning record, not purchase authority. Client data access needs separate scope approval, and recurring costs/term changes must be reapproved.
